## Non-negotiables (full set in fe-coding)

- Business logic in `_modules/`; routing files stay thin and import a Screen.
- Component hierarchy Basic → Base → Common → Domain → Screen; no raw HTML outside `Base*`.
- Navigate with `<Link>`; `router.push/replace` only for post-action redirects.
- No `as any` / `@ts-ignore`; design tokens, not hex; `t()` for user-facing text.
- Zod + React Hook Form; API responses parsed with the schema, not cast.
- Every list/fetch has loading, empty and error states.

A design (Figma link) is required for new UI: without one, ask — never approximate a screen.
